Landing.heroSubtitle: beyond-money reads your Swiss bank statements and turns raw transaction rows into crystal-clear cash flow graphs, merchant rankings, and category breakdowns.
Landing.stepsTitle: From raw export to complete financial clarity in three steps.
Landing.step1Description: Download your statement CSV or CAMT file directly from PostFinance e-finance or any Swiss bank in two clicks.
Landing.step2Description: Drop your file into Beyond Money. The intelligent local parser extracts amounts, dates, and counterparties instantly.
Landing.step3Description: Interact with real-time category splits, merchant rankings, and net savings graphs tailored to your financial life.
Landing.ctaTitle: Ready to take control of your financial story?
Landing.ctaBody: Join smart Swiss savers who track their cash flow with zero hassle and total privacy. No third-party trackers, no bank credentials stored — just crystal-clear insights.
Landing.ctaNote: Takes less than 30 seconds to begin.
Landing.faq1Question: Which banks and export formats work?
Landing.faq1Answer: PostFinance e-finance CSV exports, CAMT.053 XML standards, and standard Swiss banking exports (UBS, Raiffeisen, Neon, ZKB, Kantonalbanken) are parsed seamlessly.
Landing.faq2Question: Do I have to enter my e-banking login or password?
Landing.faq2Answer: Never. Beyond Money will never ask for your bank login or password. You simply export your statement file from your bank and upload it.
Landing.faq3Answer: Our parser inspects transaction partner names, payment purposes, and Swiss merchant registries to categorize expenses into groceries, rent, mobility, utilities, and more.
Landing.faq4Question: Can I export or purge my data at any time?
Landing.faq4Answer: Yes. You have total data sovereignty. You can delete transactions, flush statements, or reset your vault whenever you choose.
